image_qa.note: All three pages intentionally use evidence-first, image-free content. search_console.decision: The October 12–November 8 report is three days old and valid: 815 impressions, three clicks, 0.368% CTR, and average position 24.093. Arkansas had six impressions and one click at position 9.667 but was materially reinforced on November 12. The two-impression 510-versus-disposable row at position 12 already maps to a complete existing page; Delaware had only two impressions, Blue Dream had 33 impressions near position 48, and the remaining legal, health, product, and cultivar rows were single-impression noise. No new page is labeled Data-led; the report prevented a duplicate vape comparison, another Arkansas page, and a Blue Dream near-duplicate while the stale/erroring sitemap signal favored strong hub and reciprocal discovery paths.

authority.action: Published a citation-ready laboratory-limit translator grounded in New York OCM's February 9, 2026 quality-system standard plus NIST and EPA measurement references. The row translator, limit map, pass/fail reconstruction, uncertainty boundary, and package-to-limit worksheet strengthen the CoA, contaminant-results, lab-glossary, freshness, and named-cultivar evidence cluster. One qualified New York OCM laboratory public-information opportunity was logged; no outreach was sent.
